name: Sturgeon Bay Big Cubes 2024
information: Welcome to Door County's second WCA Competition! We hope to see you here this February! This competition is recognized as an official World Cube Association competition. Therefore, all competitors must be familiar with the [**WCA Regulations**](https://worldcubeassociation.org/regulations). If you are new to competing, please refer to the [**WCA Competition Tutorial**](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/edudoc/competitor-tutorial/tutorial.pdf). You can find out about upcoming competitions in our area in our local Facebook groups: [**Wisconsin and Illinois Speedcubing**](https://www.facebook.com/groups/2382471798653473) and [**Minnesota Cubing Community**](https://www.facebook.com/groups/1798123093777480) All excess funds from this competition will be donated to the church. This competition is supported by the [**Midwest Cubing Association**](https://midwestcubing.org). ![](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/rails/active_storage/blobs/redirect/eyJfcmFpbHMiOnsibWVzc2FnZSI6IkJBaHBBcll0IiwiZXhwIjpudWxsLCJwdXIiOiJibG9iX2lkIn19--c5462feacf32808de5791361d7ec2621bbee11e5/image.png)
